ideas.pitch: An interactive augmented reality web application that lets students preview next-generation Divergent hoodies and tees in 3D and AR before purchasing.
ideas.problem_statement: Conceptualise and design the next generation of Divergent student merchandise going beyond conventional graphics.
ideas.title: Divergent AR Merch Lookbook
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working live demo and interactive frontend technology which immediately stands out from static design submissions in a merch challenge.

ideas.pitch: A generative design tool that allows students to input their personal creative manifesto and automatically generates custom typographic merch graphics.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore how design, typography, illustration, colours, and storytelling can come together to represent the identity and spirit of Divergent.
ideas.title: Divergent Type-Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides judges with an engaging, interactive creation tool that proves the scalability of the design system rather than showing just a single static layout.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-voting platform for design students to rank, remix, and co-create upcoming merchandise drops based on community sentiment.
ideas.problem_statement: Merchandise that could represent a community, a mindset, a creative journey, and a way of thinking.
ideas.title: Divergent Community Design Voting Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core community-building aspect explicitly demanded by Divergent Classes, scoring high on engagement and real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: A storytelling website that pairs each merchandise piece with an interactive narrative graph mapping out the creative journey of design students.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore how design, typography, illustration, colours, and storytelling can come together to represent the identity and spirit of Divergent.
ideas.title: Divergent Visual Identity Lore Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on narrative depth and storytelling, aligning directly with Divergent Classes' core philosophy of design as communication.

ideas.pitch: A digital configurator enabling students to mix and match modular embroidered patch designs to create personalized capsule collections.
ideas.problem_statement: Conceptualise a merchandise collection that students would genuinely love to own and wear while introducing a fresh creative direction.
ideas.title: Divergent Modular Patch System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a functional, highly polished product customizer that demonstrates immense commercial viability and product-market fit.
